howCaptured: Headed Playwright, passive. The page loads its own inventory from mapwidget3.seatics.com/Api/TicketsByEvent as JSONP (positional tuples); that verbatim body is preserved in ticketsByEventJsonp. ticketGroups[] below is the SAME inventory as the page itself parsed it, with named fields, read out of Seatics.Presentation.TicketsList.currentSegments BEFORE any quantity filter was applied. No synthetic API call, no spoofing.
pricingRule: all-in per ticket, fees in, pre-tax = tgPrice + tgServiceFee = tgAllInPrice = tgDisplayPrice. Each row prints "Ticket Price $X + Fee $Y + Taxes if applicable" under a headline "$Z each", and Z === round(X+Y), so the headline is fee-inclusive and tax-exclusive.
quantityRule: purchasable as exactly 2 = splits.includes(2) && tgQty >= 2. Cross-checked against the site's own quantity=2 filter in siteQuantity2Filter.ids.
